Tie-break analysis confirms top-2 candidates are statistically tied (p=0.307), justifying diversification. All added names are from valid_candidate_names.
skeptic.when_good: When validation shows high disagreement (relative_spread_mean=0.28) and statistically tied top candidates (p=0.307)

statistician.rationale: Accepted Skeptic’s baseline addition to satisfy baseline diversity rule. Added dba_combination because its RMSE (998.5) is lower than the current best (topk_mean_per_horizon_k2) and it introduces a different combination type, breaking the statistically tied top‑1/2 and improving robustness. Added best_per_horizon_by_validation to bring in a per‑horizon selection that already leads the RMSE leaderboard (870.5). Overrode top_k of topk_mean_per_horizon_k2 to 4 and shrinkage of inverse_rmse_weights_k2_sh0.25 to 0.35 to match the recommended knobs for few windows and stronger regularization, while keeping all existing candidates to preserve the current type diversity.
statistician.when_good: When disagreement is high (relative_spread_mean≈0.28) and there are many unique winners (6), diversification and weighted/DBA methods improve robustness. Adding a baseline, a per‑horizon selector, and a strong combination candidate, along with parameter tuning for few windows, yields a more robust and high‑performing candidate set.
